title: UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration, Edit Modify Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
postName: One Time Registration (OTR) for UPSSSC Examinations
vacancyDetails: Mandatory One Time Registration (OTR) for candidates applying to UPSSSC recruitments; edit/modify facility as per commission notice
qualification: Any candidate intending to apply for UPSSSC examinations must complete OTR with correct personal, educational and contact details
ageLimit: N/A (OTR registration; age applies per individual recruitment)
applicationFee: No fee for OTR registration / modification
selectionProcess: OTR → Apply to individual Advt using OTR credentials → Exam as per post
documentsRequired: Valid mobile & email, photo, signature, educational details, Aadhaar / ID details as required on portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open OTR section: https://upsssc.gov.in/otr/
3. Complete new One Time Registration or login to modify

shortDescription: UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration 2026 open. New registration from 14 July 2026; edit/modify window as per notice (e.g. till 31 July 2026). Free at upsssc.gov.in/otr.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has activated the One Time Registration (OTR) facility for candidates.

OTR is mandatory before applying to most UPSSSC recruitments. New registration began around 14 July 2026. The commission also provides an edit / modify window for already registered candidates (as per latest notice, e.g. correction till 31 July 2026).

Key points

  • Fee: Nil for OTR
  • Portal: upsssc.gov.in/otr/
  • Modify only through official OTR Modify Login when the window is open
  • Fill photo, signature and personal details carefully

After OTR, use the same credentials to apply for individual advertisements (Excise Constable, Pharmacist, Auditor, etc.). Always verify modify dates from official notices.
